acceptanceCriteria: go-archive-gate-test and gate-receipt-test read modes with GNU stat first and pass on GNU/Linux and macOS.
error-code-ownership-check builds per-directory patterns with no empty alternative and passes under mawk, gawk and BSD awk.
check-host-package-versions.sh fails with `jq is required` when jq is absent.
Every gate step after go-test passes in golang:1.27.1 with jq, and the hosted release-gates ubuntu-24.04 full gate passes on the next candidate.
body: Observed in release-gates run 36344236053 (ubuntu-24.04 full-gate on 7075454e, job 108690109484): `make gate` stopped at go-archive-gate-test with `FAIL: a run that recorded its own witness did not pass`. Cause: script/go-archive-gate_test.sh:74 and script/gate-receipt_test.sh:79 read a mode with `stat -f '%Lp' X 2>/dev/null || stat -c '%a' X`. GNU `stat -f` is --file-system and takes no format, so it prints file-system status for X on stdout and exits 1; the fallback's mode is appended and never equals 700/600. Deterministic on every GNU/Linux host since the initial snapshot; only the macOS gate had reached these steps. Running every later gate step in golang:1.27.1 found two more portability defects that hosted ubuntu does not hit: script/check-error-code-ownership.sh:108,114 build alternations with `a[k] = (k in a) ? a[k] "|" x : x`; mawk creates a[k] before evaluating the right-hand side, so every pattern leads with an empty alternative and 363 non-code strings are reported unowned. script/check-host-package-versions.sh reads versions with jq and, without jq, reports a misleading stale bump for every package.

completion.reason: Fixed in #296 (da2d30b9). The ubuntu full gate passes go-archive-gate-test, gate-receipt-test, error-code-ownership-check and host-package-versions-check; it failed at go-archive-gate-test on 7075454e (run 36344236053) and aaaca015 (run 36346109862).
